baseline_scope: Successful all-exact collection, n equal-sized byte-identical regular files, no visual activation, no mutation/cancellation/read failure. Static source-derived full-file read counts; not measured device IO or performance.
candidate: Fuse per-pair preverification of both original snapshot digests with full byte comparison in one paired streaming pass. Retain all post-pair, post-loop and callback-free final source/dependency/model guards. Do not use digest-only equality or transitive evidence.
required_gates: Independent current exact collision/byte-boundary/mutation/cancellation tests, all original integration names retained
Collection all-pair completeness, sorted unique IDs, tagged source failure identity, identical and different digest branches
Mutation during any user callback and metadata-preserving rewrite; stale original digest must fail even when rewritten pair equals
Cancellation sticky through source/generation/provider/owner publication, no callback after final boundary
All-exact never reads model/decode dependencies; visual activation guards idle files and weights unchanged
Same-source alternating paired measurements over n/size distributions with real source validation, output equality and resource observations; no optimization acceptance from static count alone
Current full decode gate on immutable candidate snapshot, preserve earlier drifted/failed reports
expected_read_model_if_correct: 4*n + 4*(n*(n-1)/2) for all-exact only; theoretical count reduction, not measured speedup
